title: Size of the Returned Payment and the Makeup — Installment Payment Plans Training Q&A
content:
**Q. Does the size of a returned payment change the makeup on the Installment Payment Plans?**
A. Yes. For a payment returned on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term, a percentage of the returned amount (the total returned against the payment) is added to the makeup:

- returned amount of 500.00 or more: 2.5 percent;
- at least 250.00 but less than 500.00: 1 percent;
- less than 250.00: nothing.

**Q. Where do the bands meet?**
A. 499.99 takes 1 percent and 500.00 takes 2.5 percent; 250.00 takes 1 percent and 249.99 takes nothing.

**Q. Hypothetically, 640.00 was returned. What is added?**
A. 2.5 percent of 640.00, which is 16.00.
